files: a small git repository with a README, composer.json and one commit, none of the context files
evals.expected_output: Creates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, CONTEXT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, TASKS.md and .context/ (CONVENTIONS.md, HANDOFF.md, sessions/, messages/), filled from what it read, with gaps marked 'A preencher'. Adds the seven entries to .git/info/exclude. git status shows nothing new.
expectations: All context files exist after the run
git status --short is unchanged by the run
.git/info/exclude contains each of the seven entries once
No commit is created and .gitignore is untouched
Nothing that is not in the repository is stated as fact

evals.prompt: /crow:context prepare — run twice; between the runs, edit TASKS.md by hand and delete CONTEXT.md and GEMINI.md
evals.expected_output: The second run recreates only CONTEXT.md and GEMINI.md, leaves TASKS.md byte-identical with the manual edit, adds no duplicate line to .git/info/exclude, and reports criados / já existiam (mantidos).
expectations: Only the two deleted files are created
TASKS.md keeps the manual edit byte for byte
No duplicate lines in .git/info/exclude
The report separates created from kept files

files: a git repository that already commits its own CLAUDE.md
evals.expected_output: Does not edit or exclude CLAUDE.md, creates the other missing files, and asks how to proceed with CLAUDE.md.
expectations: CLAUDE.md is unchanged and not added to .git/info/exclude
The other files are created
It asks about CLAUDE.md instead of deciding

evals.prompt: /crow:context save at the end of a session that left one test failing; then, in a fresh session, /crow:context resume
evals.expected_output: save writes a HANDOFF with branch, last commit, uncommitted files and one concrete next action, appends the session log and moves finished tasks. resume reads it, checks it against git, summarises where it stopped and continues with that next action.
expectations: HANDOFF names exactly one concrete next action
The session log is appended, not rewritten
Past decisions in CONTEXT.md are not edited
resume states where it stopped before acting
resume flags a mismatch when the branch or last commit changed after the save

evals.prompt: /crow:context message codex-gpt-5 o teste de agendamento ainda falha no fuso de Manaus; então, numa sessão do Codex lendo AGENTS.md, retomar
evals.expected_output: Creates one file in .context/messages/ with from, to, date and status new. The next agent reading AGENTS.md finds it, acts on it and sets status to read.
expectations: One new file per message, named <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<from>-to-<to>.md
status starts as new
The receiving agent marks it read after acting
